title: E2E test for admin bar mobile visibility needs verification
body: tests/e2e/admin-bar-mobile-hidden.e2e.spec.ts was written but could not be executed due to a pre-existing Node.js 22 + Playwright ESM + JSON import issue (src/brands/aguy/messages/en.json needs 'type: json' import attribute). The test logic is correct and should be run manually or the infrastructure issue resolved to verify the fix.
rationale: QA requires automated verification of the fix at 375px mobile viewport.
